request.description:
Retrieves the complete configuration for the specified user account.  
This request requires no body. The authentication signature is automatically generated and signed by the collection's pre-request authentication script.

Before running the request, configure the following variables in the Collection → Variables tab:

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| userid | Your User ID |
| authKey | Authentication key from Settings → Connect |

The code snippet at the bottom of this page is automatically generated by Postman and is not executable because it does not include authentication headers or computed fields.  
To execute this request outside Postman, use the cURL example below or generate one using the test tool available at [https://app.dux-soup.com/web/rc/test](https://app.dux-soup.com/web/rc/test).

``` bash
curl -X GET "https://app.dux-soup.com/xapi/remote/control/USERID/settings" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Dux-Signature: YOUR_GENERATED_SIGNATURE"

 ```

When executing requests outside Postman:

- X-Dux-Signature must be generated from the request URL using your authKey.

request.description:
Updates one or more configuration values for the specified STACKED account.  
Only the settings you wish to change need to be included in the request body. All other settings remain unchanged.  
Some fields required by the API (targeturl, timestamp, and userid) are automatically generated and signed by the collection's pre-request authentication script.

Before running the request, configure the following variables in the Collection → Variables tab:

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| userid | Your Dux-Soup user ID |
| authKey | Authentication key from Settings → Connect |

**Request Parameters**

The settings field accepts any combination of supported configuration keys. See the User Settings API overview for the full list of available settings.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| settings | Yes | JSON object containing one or more settings to update |

The code snippet at the bottom of this page is automatically generated by Postman and is not executable because it does not include authentication headers or computed fields.  
To execute this request outside Postman, use the cURL example below or generate one using the xdtest tool available at [https://app.dux-soup.com/web/rc/test](https://app.dux-soup.com/web/rc/test).

``` bash
curl -X POST "https://app.dux-soup.com/xapi/remote/control/USERID/settings" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Dux-Signature: YOUR_GENERATED_SIGNATURE" \
  -d '{
    "targeturl": "https://app.dux-soup.com/xapi/remote/control/USERID/settings",
    "timestamp": 1710000000000,
    "userid": "USERID",
    "settings": {
      "autofollow": false
    }
  }'

 ```

When executing requests outside Postman:

- targeturl must exactly match the request URL
    
- timestamp must be a current Unix timestamp (milliseconds)
    
- X-Dux-Signature must be generated from the final request payload using your authKey
